'''Ilos''' was a bland [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] dotted with [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was located within the [[Ilos system/Legends|Ilos system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region<ref name="EAOC" /> and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called the [[Pabol Sleheyron/Legends|''Pabol Sleheyron'']], which connected it to the planets of [[Chalacta/Legends|Chalacta]] and [[Ilos Minor]].<ref name="TEA" />

Ilos was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ilosian]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and [[Time/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Ilosians ventured offworld and colonized hundreds of nearby planets.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ilos was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square R-10.<ref name="TEA" />
